product.summary: Discontinued Ctrl browser wallet extension, continuing the former XDEFI Wallet extension lineage; from 2026-08-03 only recovery-phrase export remains.
product.notes: Selected extension boundary only; Ctrl mobile apps are separate. The 2024 rebrand is not treated as initial extension launch. Ctrl removed the wallet from stores on 2026-07-07, left normal wallet functionality available through 2026-08-02, and from 2026-08-03 disabled wallet features except recovery-phrase export. WLR records the extension as discontinued with support ended.

events.title: Ctrl Wallet shut down normal wallet functionality
events.description: Ctrl announced a permanent shutdown: after removal from app and browser-extension stores on July 7, 2026, normal wallet functionality remained available through August 2 and from August 3 only recovery-phrase export remained while wallet features were disabled.
events.notes: The surviving recovery-phrase export path is a recovery mechanism, not normal wallet operation. The canonical Ctrl entity is therefore corrected to dead and the extension product to discontinued/support ended as of 2026-08-03.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site states Ctrl is non-custodial and confirms migration of the former XDEFI browser extension to Ctrl.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet Deprecation: What You Need to Know
evidence.notes: First-party Ctrl notice states the wallet is permanently shutting down, was removed from stores on July 7, remains normally functional only through August 2, and from August 3 allows only recovery-phrase export while wallet features are disabled.
